notes:
Root cause of the nonce-stall failure mode (T530/T544 burns), with the fix and the proof.

ROOT CAUSE (named, file:line). The bundle DID reach the model; the worker was killed mid-work, and the 'FAIL nonce' report was misleading.

1. Primary (T530, the 45-min wall burn): pi --provider deepseek -p <prompt> in its DEFAULT text mode buffers ALL output until the final reply — zero stdout/stderr for the whole run (its reasoning and tool calls go only to ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<uuid>.jsonl). tools/runner's progress watchdog keys on '[progress]' lines in the captured STREAMS (stderr branch only); seeing none it classifies the worker as a 'silent child' and SIGKILLs at --max-wall. Proven by re-running the exact dispatch command: 'Follow untracked/T530-*.md' produced 0 bytes over 80 s while the session JSONL showed the worker reading the bundle and running bash tools line-for-line (read bundle -> git status -> read mutants.md -> vb_mutants.zig diff). So verify_dispatch's 'FAIL nonce: the worker did not read (or echo) the instruction bundle' is a mis-diagnosis of a premature kill.

2. Secondary (T544, the instant re-burn loop): tools/runner exits 124 at LAUNCH when an unread pause/kill directive is pending (the launch-time _check_directives call). T544's D047 PAUSE was never acked (the worker never spawned to run 'managent inbox --ack'), so heal_dispatch reopened the row and every re-dispatch hit the SAME unread directive and exited 124 instantly — a loop that never lets the bundle reach the model.

FIX (committed):
- bin/subagent:259 — the deepseek pi command now passes '--mode json', which makes pi STREAM its session events (session metadata, reasoning, tool calls, usage) to stdout in real time instead of buffering until the end. This is the liveness signal the runner needs.
- tools/runner:1399 (_is_agent_lane) + :1629 (--startup-timeout, default 600 s) + :1927/:1939 (any stdout/stderr output from an agent lane marks progress, so a streaming pi/claude worker is never mis-classified 'silent') + :2126 (an agent lane that emits NOTHING within --startup-timeout is SIGKILLed with 'startup liveness timeout', a loud 10-minute anomaly instead of a silent 45-minute burn). Non-agent commands (zig build-shaped) are untouched — the check and the stdout-as-progress signal are scoped to agent lanes.

REGRESSION (test-first): tools/regression-runner-startup-liveness.sh — written red (the --startup-timeout flag was unrecognised, all three arms failed), then green after the fix. Arms: red (silent pi-named stub killed at --startup-timeout with 'startup liveness timeout'), green (stub that echoes the nonce is untouched), scoping (non-agent command silent past the timeout is untouched). Wired into zig build test (build.zig, after the runner-guard block).

PROOF (real dispatch shape): tools/runner -- pi --provider deepseek --model deepseek-v4-pro --mode json -p 'Reply with exactly one line: NONCE-...' in a scratch repo — exit 0, the nonce appeared in stdout (streamed JSON events), the runner logged 'progress watchdog active (first agent-lane stdout seen)', and no startup-liveness kill fired.

OUT OF SCOPE, OBSERVED: regression-dispatch.sh and regression-dispatch-verification.sh are RED independent of this change — their stub workers call 'managent done --status pass' WITHOUT the --impression/--impression-waiver flag that the T522 close gate now requires, so the stub's done is refused (rc=1, nonce never echoed). Pre-existing; the stub fixtures need the T522 flags, which is not T586's scope.
